questions.question: How long is the driving part of the practical car test?
questions.explanation: The practical drive lasts around 35 minutes, including independent driving.

questions.question: What happens if you make one serious or dangerous fault on the test?
options: You get a warning and continue
It counts as two driving faults
questions.explanation: Even one serious or dangerous fault means you do not pass the test.

questions.question: What should you do if you miss a turn during independent driving?
options: Carry on safely and follow the new route
Stop in the road and reverse back
Turn sharply across lanes at the last moment
questions.explanation: Taking a wrong turn safely is not a fault; unsafe corrections are.
